results.title: Unauthenticated requests are rejected
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth §Overview: servers MUST respond with HTTP 401 Unauthorized when a protected request lacks a valid token — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization
results.detail: Sent an unauthenticated request to the configured MCP endpoint (https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp) and got HTTP 401 Unauthorized, as an agent would expect before it has logged in.

results.title: 401 response includes a resource-metadata pointer
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Discovery §Protected Resource Metadata: the 401/403 response SHOULD include a resource_metadata link in WWW-Authenticate to bootstrap discovery — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery
results.detail: The WWW-Authenticate header on https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp points to a resource metadata document at https://mcp.supabase.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp — an agent can follow this link to find out how to log in, with no prior knowledge of the server.

evidence.www_authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_request", error_description="No access token was provided in this request", resource_metadata="https://mcp.supabase.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"

results.title: Protected Resource Metadata is published
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Discovery: servers MUST implement RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata with an authorization_servers array — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery
results.detail: Found a Protected Resource Metadata document at https://mcp.supabase.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp — it names 1 Authorization Server(s) (https://api.supabase.com) and 13 permission scope(s) advertised: organizations:read, projects:read, projects:write, database:write, database:read, analytics:read.... A scope is a named permission an agent can be granted (e.g. 'read:issues') — the fewer and narrower the scopes, the less an agent can do if its token leaks.

results.title: Metadata is reachable via both discovery paths
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Discovery: clients MUST support both discovery paths; servers SHOULD implement both for maximum client compatibility — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery
results.detail: The login-server pointer is reachable both ways: via the WWW-Authenticate header pointer and via the standard /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource path.

results.title: Access token is transmitted via the Authorization header only
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth §Access Token Usage: tokens MUST be sent in the Authorization: Bearer header and MUST NOT appear in the URI query string — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization
results.detail: The Protected Resource Metadata advertises 'header' as the only accepted way to send the token (bearer_methods_supported: ['header']).

results.title: Authorization Server metadata is published
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Discovery §AS Metadata Discovery: the authorization server MUST provide RFC 8414 or OpenID Connect Discovery metadata — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery
results.detail: The login server at https://api.supabase.com publishes its configuration via OAuth Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414), fetched from https://api.supabase.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.

results.title: Authorization Server metadata issuer is self-consistent
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Discovery §AS Metadata (RFC 8414 §3.3 / OIDC §4.3): the issuer in AS metadata MUST equal the issuer identifier used to construct the well-known URL — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery
results.detail: The 'issuer' field in the login server's configuration document ('https://api.supabase.com') exactly matches the address it was fetched from, confirming it's the genuine document for this server and not a mismatched copy served from elsewhere.

results.title: Client registration mechanism is classified
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Registration: Client ID Metadata Documents are the preferred registration mechanism. Dynamic Client Registration is deprecated and remains available only for backwards compatibility with authorization servers that do not yet support Client ID Metadata Documents — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/client-registration
results.detail: Only Dynamic Client Registration is advertised, at https://api.supabase.com/platform/oauth/apps/register. The specification deprecates Dynamic Client Registration in favor of Client ID Metadata Documents, which this login server does not advertise — a new agent can still register, but only through the deprecated path.

results.title: Every evaluated endpoint uses HTTPS
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth §Communication Security: remote MCP endpoints and Authorization Server endpoints MUST use TLS — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/transports/streamable-http
results.detail: All 5 checked endpoint(s) use HTTPS (mcp_endpoint, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, registration_endpoint, issuer).

results.title: PKCE (S256) is advertised
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Security §Authorization Code Protection: PKCE with S256 is REQUIRED; code_challenge_methods_supported MUST include S256 — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/security-considerations
results.detail: The login server advertises PKCE with method S256 (methods advertised: ['S256', 'plain']). PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) stops a stolen authorization code from being redeemed by anyone but the agent that started the login.

results.title: Advertised scopes are narrowly defined (least privilege)
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Security §Scope Minimization: scopes SHOULD be granular and operation-specific; overly broad scopes raise blast radius — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/security-considerations
results.detail: 5 of 13 advertised permission scope(s) look broad or write-capable: projects:write, database:write, edge_functions:write, environment:write, storage:write. If an agent requests the full advertised set, its access could exceed what it actually needs to do its job.

results.title: Unregistered redirect URIs are rejected
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Registration: the AS MUST validate exact redirect URIs, restricting them to localhost/127.0.0.1 or HTTPS, and reject foreign/open-redirect targets — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/client-registration
results.detail: Requires an authenticated session; re-run with --auth.

results.title: PKCE is enforced
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Security §Authorization Code Protection: PKCE MUST be enforced; an auth request with no valid code_challenge MUST be rejected — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/security-considerations
results.detail: Requires an authenticated session; re-run with --auth.

results.title: Access token is bound to this resource (audience binding)
results.spec_ref: MCP Auth Security: servers MUST support the resource parameter (RFC 8707) and issue tokens whose audience is bound to the canonical server URI — https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft/basic/authorization/security-considerations
